title: Quality Studio per-project rule configuration
description: Optional file at <repository>/.quality/rules.config.json. Lists only deviations from the rule library's shipped defaultOn set; the default set itself is not repeated here. Versioned with the code, exactly like any other reviewed file. Absence of this file means every defaultOn rule applies unmodified.

overrides.description: Keyed by rule id. Each entry adjusts one rule for this project only; it never adds a rule that isn't in the shipped library.

enabled.description: false disables the rule for this project. true enables an off-by-default rule. The next review-input resolution observes the change; no central setting or sync step is involved.

severity.description: Project-local default severity. It replaces the library severity in named prompt context and input priority; reviewers still judge whether the concrete evidence warrants a finding.

reason.description: Why this project deviates from the default. Required in review so overrides stay explainable, not schema-enforced.
